### Description
This PR attempts to add CTS service to Bluetooth subsystem.

### Changes
- Added CTS implementation and Required KConfig/CMake changes.
- Updated `samples/bluetooth/peripheral` to use this implementation instead of custom one.

Fixes: #77595

issue_context.title: Bluetooth: services: add CTS implementation
issue_context.body:
Spin-off from https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/73503

There is a stubbed-out implementation of the Current Time Service in the `samples/bluetooth/peripheral` application.
It doesn't do anything, apart from formatting the time in the service's wire format.

Let's implement it properly, and allow applications to use it.

The API needs not to concern itself with getting the time from the system, but rather allow the application to set and get the time, as the app may have multiple time backends.

The API could consist of
- a `cts_register_changed(app_cb)` that would register an application callback. That cb would have as params the new time (probably re-using the spec-defined struct) and the reason for the change.
- a `cts_notify(newtime, reason)` function that the app can call. `newtime` could also re-use the spec-defined struct.

We can make this service a singleton for now, and think about multiple instances later.
